name: app-results-slide-feedback-pills-and-dot-charts
title: Results slide with feedback pills and dot-matrix charts
whatItIs: A pale grey slide numbered 07 with a light headline. User feedback is set as three white capsule bubbles with avatars, and three small white cards at the bottom show a dot-matrix bar chart, a semicircle gauge (86%) and a thin-line bar chart, each with a dark pill percentage.
whatItMeans: Reassuring and clean; results feel measured and humane thanks to the pills and tiny charts.
techniques: Show quotes as chat-like capsules with a circular avatar.
Draw charts from dots or thin lines rather than fills.
Use dark rounded pills for headline percentages.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded bubble holding a short quote with an avatar.
A bar chart made of a grid of dots.
A dark rounded label with a percentage.
